articles.summary: CALGARY, Alberta, April 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Enerflex Ltd. (TSX: EFX) (NYSE: EFXT) (“Enerflex” or the “Company”) plans to release its financial results and operating highlights for the three months ended March 31, 2026, on Thursday, May 7, 2026 prior to market open.
articles.title: Enerflex Ltd. Announces Timing of First Quarter Financial and Operational Results and Schedules Virtual Investor Update
